title: Ankhorage Board
summary: Provides explicit Ankh provider bootstraps for boarding websites and source artifacts into Ankhorage.
purpose: Provide an explicit, capability-based boundary for importing website and OpenAPI sources and generating boarding manifests.
responsibilities: Expose website-source import, OpenAPI-source import, and manifest-generation capabilities.
Provide a public CLI and capability entrypoint.
Produce deterministic boarding plans for public website URLs.
boundaries: Does not own the destination application's persisted source data.
Does not silently select an import provider outside its explicit capability boundary.
Does not replace application-specific source authorization policy.
audience: Tools that bootstrap website or source-artifact boarding.
useCases: Inspect a public website URL and emit a deterministic boarding plan.
Generate a boarding manifest from a boarded source.

architecture.role: Tooling package that exposes explicit Ankh provider capabilities and a CLI delivery edge.
invariants: Boarding operations are exposed through declared package capabilities.
Provider bootstrap remains explicit rather than implicit in consuming applications.

limitations: Only the package's declared website, OpenAPI, and manifest capabilities are available through its provider.
